en:
dayday330 is a public mental health promotion initiative launched by New Life Psychiatric Rehabilitation Association in 2019. It encourages everyone to set aside time each day to practise "3-3-0 micro-breaks" — small moments to care for the Body (3), Mind (3) and Spirit (0) in ways that suit their personal preferences and lifestyle.

Research has shown that taking daily micro-breaks can effectively relieve emotional strain and reduce stress. Through simple and sustainable practices, individuals can gradually build healthier habits and strengthen their overall well-being.

We also encourage participants to draw inspiration from the "Five Ways to Wellbeing" proposed by the New Economics Foundation in the UK when choosing their 330 micro-break activities. These include: Take Notice, Be Active, Give, Connect, and Keep Learning. By incorporating these elements into everyday life, individuals can nourish their body, mind and spirit, and steadily cultivate a more fulfilling life.

en:
330 Day is the annual flagship mental wellness campaign organised by dayday330 every March. Since 2019, we have continuously introduced large-scale public initiatives in different formats to promote the concept of 330 micro-breaks — encouraging people to reserve a small moment each day to care for their body, mind and spirit, and to gradually reshape their life rhythm through small but meaningful changes.

330 Day 2026 – Sense · To Live is a month-long, city-wide initiative taking place throughout March. Through experiences engaging the five senses — sight, sound, smell, taste and touch — participants are invited to rediscover the present moment within familiar daily settings and practise awareness within the urban environment.

Through a series of interactive missions and experiential activities, the programme encourages "sensing" to become part of everyday living. By cultivating sustainable micro-break habits, participants can reconnect with themselves, their communities and the rhythm of the city.

en:
330 Day 2026 Sense · To Live is a month-long, city-wide initiative taking place throughout March. Through experiences engaging the five senses—sight, sound, smell, taste, and touch—the programme invites participants to reconnect with the present moment within familiar daily settings. By encouraging sustainable micro-break habits, Sense · To Live integrates mindful sensing into everyday life, making "feeling" a natural part of living.

How Sense · To Live Works

The City Five Senses Journey
During the campaign period, participants can take part in five senses themed missions across different corners of the city, in collaboration with dayday330 partners and designated locations.

Each mission is designed to be short, accessible, and repeatable, allowing participants to engage consciously with their senses without disrupting their existing daily routines.

Five-Senses Missions Include (but are not limited to):

Sight
Rediscover overlooked details in everyday surroundings through observation and visual awareness.
Sound
Pause to listen and recognize layers and rhythms within the surrounding environment.
Smell
Notice how scents evoke memories and emotional responses.
Taste
Engage fully in the act of eating, paying attention to texture, flavor, and change.
Touch
Heighten bodily awareness through sensations such as temperature, weight, and texture.

After completing each mission, participants may record their experiences on the designated 330 Day mobile page, gradually building a personal collection of five-senses experiences.
Participation & Game Mechanics

Join the Journey
Participants may join the Sense · To Live via the 330 Day mobile page to access campaign guidelines and mission details.

Complete Five Senses Missions
Participants follow instructions to complete sensory missions at partner locations or within their daily lives. The missions emphasize self-awareness, with no standard answers and no right or wrong outcomes.

Collect Five Senses Stamps
Each completed mission earns a corresponding five senses stamp. By collecting a designated number of stamps, participants can unlock commemorative rewards at different stages of the journey.

Reward Redemption
During the campaign period, participants who complete the designated five-senses missions and successfully collect the required stamps may redeem 330 Day 2026 limited-edition commemorative items at *designated locations.

Closing Event – Five Senses Carnival

As one of the key highlights of 330 Day 2026 Sense · To Live, a closing event titled "Five Senses Carnival" will be held on 28–29 March 2026 at The Wai, Tai Wai, bringing together the collective five-senses experiences from throughout March through a variety of interactive booths.

The event will showcase selected five senses themed interactive content and experiential installations, allowing participants to revisit and extend their sensory journey from the past month within a shared physical space. Through participation and exchange, the public is invited to complete a collective five senses moment belonging to the city.

A Closing Ceremony will take place on 29 March 2026, marking a meaningful conclusion to the Sense ·To Live.

聽覺：為聲音停留片刻，辨認環境中的層次與節奏

嗅覺：留意氣味帶來的記憶與情緒反應

味覺：專注進食過程，感受食物的質感與變化

觸覺：透過身體感受，覺察溫度、重量與觸感

完成每項任務後，參與者可於指定330Day手機專頁記錄體驗，逐步累積屬於自己的五感印記。

加入旅程

完成五感任務
按照指引於合作地點或日常生活中完成指定感官任務。任務設計強調「自我覺察」，不設標準答案，亦無對錯之分。

收集五感印章
每完成一項感官任務，參與者可獲得對應的五感印章。完成指定數量的印章，即可解鎖不同階段的紀念獎賞。

• Practise mindfulness

• Learn new things

en: 💡 Important: You must enable 'Precise Location' option, otherwise the system will only provide approximate location information, which may prevent you from starting missions.
zh-hk: 💡 重要：必須開啟「精準位置」選項，否則系統只會提供模糊的位置資訊，可能無法開啟任務。
方法二：透過 Safari 瀏覽器設定

en: Open Safari browser and navigate to this website

在「定位」選項中選擇「允許」

en: 💡 Important: Make sure to enable 'Precise Location' to get accurate geographic coordinates for successfully starting missions.

en: Note: Different Android versions and manufacturers may have slightly different settings interfaces, but the steps are generally similar.

zh-hk: 確保您的設備 GPS 功能已開啟（通常在下拉通知欄中可快速開啟）

en: Try closing and reopening the browser or app
zh-hk: 嘗試關閉並重新開啟瀏覽器或應用程式

en: Check if other apps are using GPS resources, temporarily close other location-related apps
zh-hk: 檢查是否有其他應用程式佔用 GPS 資源，暫時關閉其他定位相關應用

en: Move to an open outdoor area, avoid tall buildings or indoor environments that may interfere with signals
zh-hk: 移動到開闊的戶外空間，避免高樓大廈或室內環境影響訊號

en: Turn on Wi-Fi and mobile data to improve location accuracy

en: Wait a few minutes for the device to acquire more GPS satellites

en: Check if your browser is set to clear site permissions when browsing history is cleared

zh-hk: 關閉其他應用程式的對話框或重疊視窗，這些可能會阻擋權限請求

en: Why do I need GPS location?
zh-hk: 為什麼需要使用 GPS 定位？

zh-hk: 部分任務需要確認您在指定地點才能開始，這是為了確保您能夠完整體驗活動內容。

en: Will my location information be saved?
zh-hk: 我的位置資訊會被保存嗎？

en: We only use location information for verification when you execute missions and do not permanently save your location records. We value your privacy and security.
zh-hk: 我們只會在您執行任務時使用位置資訊進行驗證，不會永久保存您的位置記錄。我們重視您的隱私安全。

en: Can I participate using a desktop computer?
zh-hk: 可以使用桌面電腦參與嗎？

zh-hk: 建議使用具有 GPS 功能的手機或平板電腦參與活動，以獲得最佳體驗。部分桌面電腦可能不支援精確定位。

en: What if it still doesn't work after setup?

zh-hk: 請嘗試重新啟動設備，或聯繫我們的客戶服務團隊尋求協助。

en: What is the "330 Day City Five Senses Journey"?
zh-hk: 甚麼是「330 Day 城市五感旅程」？

en:
The "330 Day City Five Senses Journey" is an urban interactive experience themed around the five senses (sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch). Participants enter different communities, complete diverse missions, train their awareness, and rediscover familiar yet overlooked details of the city in everyday scenes.

Through exploring street scenery, community sounds, local scents, and human warmth, participants reconnect not only with themselves but also with the city and community, focus on the present, and rediscover a healthy rhythm of mind, body, and spirit.
zh-hk:
「330 Day 城市五感旅程」是一個以五感（視覺、聽覺、嗅覺、味覺、觸覺）為主題的城市互動體驗活動。參加者透過走進不同社區、完成多元任務，訓練覺察力，在日常場景中重新認識熟悉卻被忽略的城市細節。

透過探索街道風景、社區聲音、地方氣味與人情溫度，參加者不但重新連結自己，也重新連結城市與社區，專注當下，重拾健康身心靈的節奏。

en: Simply visit the designated 330 Day mobile webpage, register an account, and tap "Find Nearby Missions" to start, or browse the mission list to enter a mission. No app download is required.
zh-hk: 只需進入 330 Day 指定手機網頁，註冊帳戶後，按「查看附近的任務」，即可開始任務，或到任務列表進入任務，毋須下載應用程式。

en: Do I need to register or pay?
All activities are free to participate.
Who is the event suitable for?
People of all ages are welcome to join. Some missions involve walking or outdoor activities; please participate according to your physical condition.
zh-hk: 任何年齡人士都可參加。部分任務涉及步行或戶外活動，建議按個人身體狀況參與。

en: Can I complete missions more than once?
Each mission counts only once for stamp records, but you are welcome to revisit locations and experience them again.
zh-hk: 每項任務只會計算一次印章紀錄，但您可重遊地點，再次體驗。

en: Why use the five senses as the event theme?
zh-hk: 為何以五感作為活動主題？

en: The five senses are the foundation of human interaction with the environment. By training awareness of sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch, participants are encouraged to slow down and reconnect with themselves and the city. Multiple psychology and neuroscience studies indicate that focused sensory practices can help reduce stress, improve concentration, and promote emotional stability.
zh-hk: 五感是人與環境互動的基礎。透過訓練視覺、聽覺、嗅覺、味覺及觸覺的覺察能力，鼓勵參加者放慢節奏，重新連結自己與城市。多項心理學及神經科學研究指出，專注於感官經驗的練習有助降低壓力、提升專注力及促進情緒穩定。

en: Awareness means consciously noticing current bodily sensations, emotional changes, and environmental information without rushing to judge or react.
zh-hk: 覺察是有意識地留意當下的身體感受、情緒變化及環境訊息，而不急於作出評價或反應。

en: The "330 Micro-Break" encourages setting aside a little time each day for body (3), mind (3), and spirit (0), using simple and consistent habits to help relieve stress and stabilize emotions.
zh-hk: 「330 小休息」鼓勵每天為身（3）、心（3）、靈（0）留出一點時間，透過簡單而持續的習慣，幫助舒緩壓力與穩定情緒。

en: After completing missions, how can I extend the practice into daily life?
zh-hk: 完成任務後，如何延伸至日常生活？

en: You can integrate five-sense observation into everyday life—for example, mindfully savoring the taste of a meal, noticing layers of city sounds, or feeling different textures, gradually cultivating a habit of awareness.
zh-hk: 可將五感觀察方式融入日常，例如專心感受一餐食物的味道、留意城市聲音層次或觸摸不同材質的感受，逐步培養覺察習慣。

en: Missions are categorized by the five senses and come in various formats, including observation questions, multiple-choice questions, photo tasks, matching games, or GPS location tasks.
zh-hk: 任務按五感分類，並設有不同形式，例如：觀察題、多項選擇題、拍照任務、對對碰遊戲或GPS定位任務。

en: Is there a time limit for missions?
There is no time limit for missions; participants can complete them at their own pace.
zh-hk: 任務沒有時間限制，參加者可根據自己的節奏完成任務。

en: How do I confirm a mission is successfully completed?
zh-hk: 完成任務後如何確認成功？

en: A "Mission Completed" message will appear on screen, and a stamp will be automatically recorded.
zh-hk: 成功後畫面會顯示「完成任務」提示，同時自動記錄印章。

en: Are there right or wrong answers for missions?
Missions do not have right or wrong answers. Participants simply need to record their feelings in the moment; the goal is to observe and reflect.
zh-hk: 任務沒有對與錯，參加者只需記下當刻的感受，鼓勵透過觀察與思考完成每個任務。

en: Why do I need to enable location services?
zh-hk: 為何需要開啟定位功能？

en: Each mission requires confirmation that you have arrived at the nearby mission area before it can begin.
zh-hk: 每個任務都需要確認您已抵達附近任務範圍方能開始。

en: How do I enable location services?
Please allow "Location Access" in your mobile browser and ensure your phone's GPS is activated.
zh-hk: 請在手機瀏覽器中允許「定位存取」，並確保手機GPS已啟動。

en: What should I do if I still cannot complete the mission after arriving?
zh-hk: 到達現場仍無法完成任務怎麼辦？

en: Try refreshing the page, or check whether your location mode is set to "High Accuracy".
zh-hk: 請嘗試重新整理頁面，或確認定位模式是否設為「高精準度」。

en: Will my location be tracked continuously?
zh-hk: 是否會長期追蹤我的位置？

en: The system only reads location data during mission execution and does not store your movements long-term.
zh-hk: 系統只在任務進行時讀取定位資料，不會長期儲存個人行蹤。

en: Does the website require an app download?
No app download is required; simply participate via your mobile browser.
zh-hk: 毋須下載App，只需透過手機瀏覽器即可參與。

en: How can I view completed missions?
Go to the "Mission Records" page to view your completed missions.
zh-hk: 進入「任務記錄」頁面，可查看已完成任務。

en: What should I do if the website is not working?
zh-hk: 如果網頁運行不到怎麼辦？

en: We recommend using the latest version of your browser and maintaining a stable internet connection.
zh-hk: 建議使用最新版本瀏覽器，並保持穩定網絡連線。

en: Will changing my phone affect my records?
zh-hk: 更換手機是否會影響紀錄？

en: The event has an account login function; simply log in with the same method to retain your records.
zh-hk: 活動設有帳戶登入功能，只需要使用同一登入方式便可保留紀錄。

en: Is there a limited quantity of gifts?
Gifts are limited in quantity and available while stocks last.
zh-hk: 禮品數量有限，換完即止。

en: Is there a deadline for redeeming gifts?
All gifts must be redeemed at the designated locations on or before 30 April 2026. Some gifts will be available for redemption after 20 March; please refer to the instructions on the gifts page.
zh-hk: 所有禮品需在2026年4月30日或之前到指定地方換領，部分禮品將在3月20日後開始換領，敬請細閱禮品頁面內的說明。

en: Can I block passageways or gather during the event?
zh-hk: 參與活動期間，是否可以阻礙通道或聚集停留？

en: No. Participants must not block pedestrian passageways, entrances/exits or public spaces, nor gather in ways that cause congestion. Please ensure normal passage for others is not affected.
zh-hk: 不可。參與者不得阻塞行人通道、出入口或公共空間，亦不應聚集造成擠塞。請確保不影響他人正常通行。

en: Can I touch, lean on, or use public facilities?
zh-hk: 是否可以觸碰、倚靠或使用公共設施？

en: Except under normal usage conditions, participants must not touch, climb, or lean on public facilities. Event missions do not involve any facility operation; please comply with venue rules.
zh-hk: 除正常使用情況外，不得觸碰、攀爬或倚靠公共設施。活動任務不涉及任何設施操作，請遵守場地規則。

en: What should I be aware of when doing photography or video tasks?
zh-hk: 進行拍照或錄影任務時需要注意什麼？

en: Please avoid obstructing others or disrupting public order, and do not perform dangerous actions. Respect others' privacy when photographing and do not photograph individuals without their consent.
zh-hk: 請避免阻礙他人通行或影響公共秩序，不得進行危險動作。拍攝時應尊重他人私隱，未經同意不得拍攝他人肖像。

en: Do minors need to be accompanied when participating?
zh-hk: 未成年人參與活動是否需要陪同？

en: Participants under 12 years of age are recommended to be accompanied by a parent or guardian, who should assess safety conditions on site.
zh-hk: 建議12歲以下參加者由家長或監護人陪同參與，並由監護人自行評估現場安全情況。

en: If you have any enquiries, please contact us.
